name: YOUR NAME

line.use: Hairlines, timeline track, borders at rest

signal.use: HERO ACCENT. Glows, key words, cursor, active states

ember.use: SECOND ACCENT. Money, results, numbers, 'premium' cards

success.use: Passed / shipped / it works moments only

ratios: 70% ink/footage, 20% text white, 8% signal cyan, 2% ember. Never use ember and signal on the same word.

serif.use: Emotional / storytelling words — the human side

mono.use: Labels, tags, numbers in UI, terminal cards — the engineer side

logo.concept: A terminal prompt chevron with a blinking cursor: the moment before you ship.
